# Oh-My-Dogcare Skill for Muse

An AI notebook for dog owners: per-dog profiles, daily observation logs, breed-aware reminders for vaccines, deworming and rechecks, vet-visit prep that condenses scattered symptoms into a 30-second chief complaint, decisive emergency triage that points straight to the vet when red flags appear, positive-method training and reactivity logs, and printable or shareable exports (visit summaries, medication lists from existing prescriptions, weight cards). The guardrails are strict and explicit: it never diagnoses, never doses or prescribes medication, never replaces a vet or trainer — and the one exception is transcription of a vet's existing prescription, confirmed with the owner first. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the SKILL.md content is bilingual Chinese/English (中文/EN); everything is stored locally in `~/.petcare/` files under the owner's control, and no file is written without confirmation. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
